situation: A woman drops her house keys inside her living room, and they land on the wooden planks.
subject: the floor
brief: A cross-section of a cosy living room reveals a polished wooden surface stretching horizontally across the entire lower frame, where a small set of metal keys has just clattered down. The flat boards underneath everything else form the undisputed base of the entire scene, brightly lit and clearly textured.
prompt: A cross-section of a cosy living room reveals a polished wooden surface stretching horizontally across the entire lower frame, where a small set of metal keys has just clattered down. The flat boards underneath everything else form the undisputed base of the entire scene, brightly lit and clearly textured. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
